docs.title: Notice translation
docs.summary: Translates public notices into the languages residents read.
docs.facets: Translation & language access Communications & outreach Public-facing Live

sections.t: Residents were receiving code enforcement letters they could not read.
The tool drafts a plain language version of each notice and routes it to a bilingual reviewer before anything is mailed.
Fork the prompt library, swap in your own notice templates, and keep the reviewer step. The reviewer step is what makes this safe to run at all.
